notes: Competing reading for the italic *there will be*: joining it to דֵי as the clause's nominal anchor; taken on the לְ because rule 49 puts the copula of a verbless clause on the preposition heading its predicate and rule 20 sends the presentative dummy with the copula. The italics corroborate but do not decide it (rule 7).
Review: דֵי חֲלֵב עִזִּים is rendered attributively as *goats milk enough*, so rule 28 governs and no *of* is placed on the rectum; each of the three suffixes takes the possessive written for it.
